notes.title: The Era of Pioneers Demo Launch
notes.notes: [p][i]Dreamed of dappled light under an old tree? Grandpa's wrinkled hand waving a fan? Golden fields melting into sunset?[/i] [b]The Era of Pioneers[/b] [i]brings this to life.[/i][/p][p][i]Shape your character: customize looks and traits.[/i][/p][p][i]Bond with NPCs to build community spirit.[/i][/p][p][i]Farm strategically: choose seeds, manage tools/storage, adapt to seasons.[/i][/p][p][i]Sell crops at markets; get low-interest loans from rural credit cooperatives.[/i][/p][p][i]Build homes, lead democratic village governance.[/i][/p][p][i]From every wisp of smoke to each brick – your story begins now.[/i][/p]
